test.name: Census page: two households on one page stay two households
test.description: A transcribed 1860 census page carries two dwellings. The agent must write one document with each person's `household`, so code assigns a head per household; merging them makes Michael Gallagher a member of the Flynn household. 1860 has no relationship column, so no relationship is stated. Every age gives a computed birth year.

input.delegation:

judge_context: The agent reads the page, makes one extraction_append call carrying one document with a `household` on each person, and returns the tool's summary verbatim. Roles and classifications are decided in code from the document; grade what the agent READ and whether the reply is the summary, not the classifications.
1860 schedules have no relationship-to-head column: a statedRelation or relationship on this page is inferred, not read.
